admin.autoModelDesc: Configure auto model ID and view platform model discovery status
admin.dataManagerDesc: Export and import system data for backup and migration
admin.dmBusinessDataDesc: API Keys, request logs, statistics, audit logs, etc.
admin.dmDropHint: Click or drag a file here
admin.dmTipMigrate: • Migrating to a new server: export first, then import

admin.devicesDesc: Devices registered on startup, identified by NODE_NAME (with platform-name fallback). Each device has a stable UUID, reused across restarts

devices.deleteConfirmDesc: Device "{name}" will be removed. It will re-register on next startup with a fresh UUID.
devices.emptyDesc: Devices are registered automatically when Docker containers start. Set NODE_NAME to distinguish multi-instance deployments.
devices.cfStubDesc: Device registration is stubbed on Cloudflare deployments — the data layer is omitted from the Pages Function bundle. Use a Docker / EdgeOne / Vercel deployment to manage devices.

platform.name: Platform Name
platform.platformUnbanTip: Click to manually restore platform from circuit-breaker state
platform.platformDownTip: Platform is in circuit-breaker (down) state — manual restore available
platform.keyStatusTip: Some API keys are temporarily banned/deprioritized after 429, auto-recovered on expiry
platform.keyStatusSummary: {count} API key(s) temporarily banned/deprioritized after 429 (banned {banned}, deprioritized {deprioritized}), auto-recovered on expiry
platform.batchAddKeyPlaceholder:
One key per line, duplicates auto-removed
sk-xxx
sk-yyy
platform.batchAddKeyHint: Auto-skips empty lines, duplicates of existing keys, and duplicates within batch
platform.batchAddKeyAllDup: All keys already exist, no new keys added
platform.whitelistRemoveTip: Whitelisted (not banned on 429, click to remove)
platform.platformWhitelistedDesc: Whitelisted platforms will never be banned (keys still get banned normally)
platform.proxyStrictOff: Fall back to platform proxy if unavailable
platform.deletePlatformDesc: This action cannot be undone. All request logs and statistics of this platform will also be deleted.
platform.keyRequired: Please enter at least one API key
platform.keyPlaceholderEdit: Leave empty to remove this key
platform.nameDesc: Display name shown in lists and detail pages
platform.baseUrlDesc: OpenAI-compatible upstream endpoint; all requests are forwarded to it
platform.typeDesc: Used for icon colors and compatibility adaptation
platform.weightDesc: Load balancing weight; higher value gets more traffic
platform.rpmDesc: Max requests per minute, unlimited if empty
platform.tpmDesc: Max tokens per minute, unlimited if empty
platform.forwardHeadersDesc: One header name per line, forwarded to upstream requests
platform.forwardHeadersPlaceholder:
One header name per line
X-Thinking-Mode
X-Reasoning-Effort
platform.forwardHeadersForbidden: These headers cannot be forwarded (would override platform auth): {names}
platform.extraHeadersInvalid: Line {lines} is invalid (expected Key: Value) and would be silently dropped on save — please fix
platform.injectStreamOptionsDesc: Send stream_options:{include_usage:true} with streaming requests; disable for strict backends (Mistral, etc.) that reject unknown fields with 422
platform.reuseUserAgentDesc: Replace downstream User-Agent with a custom value for this platform
platform.customUserAgentDesc: User-Agent string sent to upstream when override is enabled
platform.extraHeadersDesc: Always written to upstream requests regardless of downstream. One per line as Key: Value, up to 20 entries, takes priority over forwarded headers
platform.whitelistAdded: Marked for whitelist — takes effect after saving
platform.whitelistRemoved: Marked for removal from whitelist — takes effect after saving
platform.errorCountTip: Consecutive error count (429 = 1, 401 = 2, others = 1). Auto-disabled at 5. Manual enable resets to 0
platform.presetsDesc: Create a platform and its model list from a preset template in one click
platform.presetCreateDesc: Creates the platform and imports all models from this preset. Keys and models can be adjusted later on the detail page
platform.presetKeyPlaceholder: One key per line; leave empty to add later

apikey.name: Key Name
apikey.expiresAtPlaceholder: Select expiration time (optional, empty = never expires)
apikey.saveWarning: Please save this key securely, it will not be shown again:
apikey.baseUrlCfHint: When using this key, set Base URL to the companion Cloudflare Workers address (e.g. https://your-worker.workers.dev), not the upstream platform address.
apikey.baseUrlSelfHint: When using this key, set Base URL to this system's deployment address (e.g. https://your-domain.com), not the upstream platform address.
apikey.allowedIpsDesc: Restrict which client IPs can call this key. CIDR or single IP. Leave empty to allow all.
apikey.allowedModelsPlaceholder: Type and press Enter to add model ID
apikey.allowedModelsDesc: Restrict which models this key can call. Leave empty to allow all.

usage.promptTokensDesc: Total input tokens across all requests
usage.completionTokensDesc: Total output tokens across all requests
usage.avgTtftDesc: Average first token latency for streaming responses
usage.trendEmptyHint: Data will appear here after sending API requests

system.autoModelDesc: When configured, requests to this model ID will automatically round-robin across all available platforms.
system.autoModelRegenerated: Auto model ID has been regenerated
system.autoModelNoModels: No models discovered yet — add platforms and refresh to populate
system.autoModelAllEnabled: No whitelist configured — all models participate in routing; toggling any switch saves and narrows routing to the selection
system.requestTemplatesDesc: Customize upstream request format with auto-injected fields
system.rtDescPlaceholder: Describe the purpose of this template
system.rtMergeBodyHelp: Deep-merge this JSON into upstream request body
system.rtDroppedFieldsWarning: The following fields are not in the allowlist and have been ignored: {fields}
system.rtDeleteConfirm: Are you sure to delete this template?
system.rtModelsExtra: Enter model ID then press Enter to add; supports * wildcard (e.g. gpt-*)
system.rtModelsPlaceholder: Enter model ID and press Enter to confirm
system.rtTypeExtra: Chat for normal v1/chat proxy (legacy), Responses for next-gen Responses API (unlocks advanced reasoning chain)
system.sysKeyDesc: For admin API authentication (Authorization: Bearer), not for v1 proxy
system.sysKeyAlert: Keys on this page are only for admin API authentication. Create v1 proxy keys in the API Key Management page.
system.sysKeyUsageHint: System keys are only for admin API authentication and cannot be used for v1 proxy forwarding.
system.sysKeyShowOnce: The key is shown only once; copy and save it now
system.upstreamProxyGroupEnabledHelp: When disabled, this group is excluded from subscription pulls, health checks and request routing (changes take effect after saving)
system.upstreamProxyAutoRefreshHelp: When enabled, the subscription URL is pulled on a schedule based on the interval below; disabling only stops scheduled pulls — the manual "Pull now" button still works (changes take effect after saving)
system.upstreamProxyRefreshIntervalHelp: Scheduled pull interval, 1–20160 (up to 14 days); leave empty to use the default of 60 minutes
system.upstreamProxyInvalidRefreshInterval: Refresh interval must be an integer between 1 and 20160
system.upstreamProxySourceUrlHelp: Auto refresh and manual pulls fetch the proxy list from this URL: one proxy per line, bare host:port or http(s)/socks4/socks5:// prefix accepted; leave empty to use manual proxies only
system.upstreamProxyManualUrlsHelp: One per line, bare host:port or http(s)/socks4/socks5:// prefix accepted; merged with pulled results as group proxies
system.upstreamProxyDeleteGroupConfirm: After deletion, this group's proxies stop being used and bound platforms fall back to the default group
system.upstreamProxyGroupBoundPlatformsHelp: Bound platforms always use this group's proxies (no need to add them to the apply list above); unbound platforms in the apply list use the default group (first)
system.upstreamProxyGroupBoundPlatformsPlacehol: Select platforms that always use this group's proxies
system.upstreamProxyGroupNameReserved: Group name cannot be "new" (reserved for the creation page)
system.upstreamProxyInvalidSourceUrl: Pull URL must start with http:// or https://
system.upstreamProxyGroupEmpty: No proxies in this group yet — save, then pull now or wait for the scheduled task
system.upstreamProxyPlatformsPlaceholder: Select platforms to route through the proxy (empty = all)
system.upstreamProxyPlatformsHelp: Select which platforms route upstream traffic through the proxy; empty means all platforms. Platforms not bound to a group use the default group (first).
system.upstreamProxyCheckUrlHelp: Public endpoint used to probe proxy connectivity. Defaults to https://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204; custom URLs must return 2xx for anonymous GET.
system.upstreamProxyHealthIntervalHelp: On Docker deployments the scheduled task checks proxy connectivity at this interval (1–1440, up to 24 hours). Takes effect from the next scheduled check after saving.
system.upstreamProxyInvalidInterval: Health check interval must be an integer between 1 and 1440
system.upstreamProxyNoActivePullGroups: No proxy groups to pull (all disabled or no subscription URLs)
system.upstreamProxyNoHealthCandidates: No proxies to check (all groups disabled or empty)
system.upstreamProxyDegradedTip: Error rate too high in the window; routing temporarily skips this proxy until the window slides
system.upstreamProxySaveFirst: Save the configuration before pulling or checking
system.upstreamProxyPullFailed: Pull failed, the previous proxy list is kept
system.upstreamProxyPullPartial: Some groups failed to pull, their previous lists are kept
system.upstreamProxyHealthEmpty: Add a proxy group and save to run manual pull/check
system.upstreamProxyInvalidUrls: Invalid proxy address: must start with http://, https://, socks4:// or socks5://, or be host:port
system.upstreamProxyNotActive: The current deployment platform does not support the upstream proxy; saved configuration will take effect on Docker deployments
system.upstreamProxyActive: Upstream proxy enabled — upstream requests will be forwarded through the proxy server
system.upstreamProxyNoTrafficStats: No request stats for proxied traffic yet
system.upstreamProxyDisabledAll: Outbound proxy disabled via environment variable (UPSTREAM_PROXY_DISABLED=all): requests go direct; pull and health checks (including manual) are skipped
system.upstreamProxyDisabledHealth: Scheduled health checks disabled via environment variable (UPSTREAM_PROXY_DISABLED=health): the scheduler and cron endpoint skip them; manual "Check now" still works
system.upstreamProxyCronHint: Pull and health check run on schedule (cron proxy-pull / proxy-health) or manually above; stats aggregate real requests per proxy (200, 429 and other errors) with availability

home.heroDesc: Intelligent API proxy router. Multi-platform load balancing, automatic circuit breaker recovery, SSE streaming, token quota management — one-line config to connect, seamless SDK compatibility.
home.sectionCoreFeaturesDesc: Enterprise-grade proxy capabilities for AI APIs, ready to use out of the box
home.sectionQuickStartDesc: Just modify base_url to connect, seamless SDK compatibility
home.multiPlatformDesc: Support any compatible platform with weighted load balancing and automatic failover
home.sseDesc: Full support for streaming and non-streaming proxy
home.keyMgmtDesc: Flexible key distribution, usage limits and usage tracking
home.circuitBreakerDesc: Automatic circuit breaker recovery, platform-level RPM/TPM rate limiting for system stability
home.usageDesc: Detailed request logs, token usage statistics and audit logs
home.sdkCompatDesc: Standard /v1 path, compatible with mainstream SDKs, just modify base_url to connect
home.stepConfigEnvDesc: Set DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN and other environment variables
home.stepStartServiceDesc: docker-compose up -d for one-click startup with automatic database initialization
home.stepGetStartedDesc: Add upstream platforms and API Keys in the admin panel, modify base_url in your SDK to connect

settings.title: System Settings
settings.desc: Model pricing, notifications and other system-level configuration
settings.pricingUnitHint: Prices are in USD per million tokens (input / output). Upstream-reported costs always take precedence; this table is used for estimation only.
settings.pricingEmpty: No pricing entries. Add manually or import from LiteLLM.
settings.pricingErrorInvalidPrice: Invalid price for "{model}": must be non-negative numbers
settings.notifDesc: Push key bans, circuit breaker trips, service outages and quota warnings to your webhook channels (Telegram Bot / Bark / ServerChan compatible).
settings.twofaDesc: Require a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, etc.) in addition to the password at login. The secret is stored encrypted.
settings.twofaAddHint: Add this secret to your authenticator app (scan the otpauth URI or enter manually), then enter the current 6-digit code to confirm:
settings.devModeDesc: Enables verbose server logs and exposes internal debug endpoints. Off by default; only enable when actively investigating an issue.
settings.devModeEnabledOn: Developer mode is ON — debug panels below are available.
settings.devModeEmpty: No data in the selected window.

playground.title: Playground
playground.desc: Send real requests through the full proxy chain (routing, retries, logging and cost accounting) using your API Keys

notif.title: Alert Notifications
notif.desc: Push critical proxy events (key bans, circuit breaker trips, quota warnings) in real time to IM / Webhook channels.
notif.channelOptionsHint: Per type: Bark uses level/group/icon; Telegram uses chatId; ServerChan uses short/channel; Backup channel uses encryptionKey.
notif.noChannels: No channels configured. Click "Add channel" to start.
notif.eventPlatformDegraded: Platform degraded (more than half of keys failed)
notif.errorNoChannel: Enabling notifications requires at least one channel
notif.errorBadUrl: Channel "{name}" URL must start with http:// or https://
notif.errorCooldown: Cooldown must be an integer between 1 and 1440
notif.errorRetention: Retention days must be an integer between 1 and 365
notif.testNotice:
Test send actually calls the channel URL once, but does not trigger the normal notification cooldown.
History records will be marked as "(test)".
notif.backupChannelTestHint: Backup channels: please test from the Encrypted Backup page
notif.testDefaultBody:
This is a test notification body.
Used to verify channel configuration.
notif.eventsHint: Select event types to trigger. Duplicate events in the cooldown window are not resent.

backup.title: Encrypted Backup
backup.desc: Encrypted snapshot of system config + platforms + API Keys, multi-receiver push, with manual trigger and scheduled execution.
backup.runConfigMissing: No backup channel or BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL configured.
backup.configDesc: Add a type=backup channel in the "Notification Center" to include it in the push list. options.encryptionKey is required (used to derive the PBKDF2 envelope key).
backup.sharedConfigDesc: Backup channels (type=backup) share the same config as notification channels.
backup.addBackupChannelHint:
In the Notification Center, click "Add channel" → choose "Encrypted backup push" → fill in url and
options.encryptionKey to add to the push list.
backup.schedIntro: Backup is triggered by external scheduler or Cloudflare Cron, not self-running.
backup.schedCfDesc: Shares the same cron slot with log archive (03:00 daily, worker/wrangler.toml).
backup.schedDockerDesc: Not covered by Docker internal scheduler (only Pages / Cloudflare via /api/cron/backup). Configure in external cron (e.g. cron-job.org / k8s CronJob).
backup.historyHint: Click "Run backup now" to generate the first history record
backup.runNowDesc1: Build a snapshot of system config + platforms + API Keys, encrypted with AES-GCM, pushed to all enabled receivers.
backup.runNowDesc2: Typical execution time 1-3 seconds (PBKDF2 100k iter × receiver count).
